goal: Under the worker pool, every task executes and lands exactly once and only after re-verifying against the exact base it lands on, and a pool of size 1 behaves identically to today's single serial worker.

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_orchestrator.py -- test_fresh_selection_rechecks_terminal_state_under_claim (commit 4dc477b): the deterministic interleaving harness to model the exactly-once stress proof
packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- the submit-time rebase / merge-flock landing path that serializes base merges and re-runs command graders
packages/flywheel-worktree/tests/ and packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/ -- add the exactly-once, concurrent-landing, and N=1 back-compat tests here; keep the rest green
constraints: Add a deterministic (not load-dependent) stress test: M independent tasks through a pool of N with induced overlap; assert each task has exactly one DONE run and the union covers all M, none twice (criterion #4).

Add a concurrent-landing test: pool N=2, two tasks each committing a distinct graded change; assert both land, the post-drain base contains both changes, and the full suite is green on the landed base (criterion #10).
Add a back-compat test: a pool of size 1 keeps at most one task in_progress at any instant over a multi-task drain (criterion #1).
If a proof reveals the pool violates exactly-once or serialized landing, fix the pool to satisfy the invariant -- never weaken the test.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do not weaken or delete any assertion to make a test pass; exactly-once and serialized landing are out-of-band truth (the spec's must-not-regress).
Do not parallelize landing or change D-3.
edge_cases: The #4 test must induce real overlap (a slow or barriered invoke), not rely on machine load; tasks too fast to overlap must not count as a pass.
#10: a lost-update or partial/interleaved merge under concurrent completion must fail the test.
#1: a size-1 pool that runs two tasks at once must fail the test.
